chunks: The man said: By Allah, I could not refrain [from allegiance] when the proof was established against me, so I gave him allegiance, peace be upon him.
ai.seo_question: Why did Kolayb al-Jarmi swear allegiance to Imam Ali (AS)?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Kolayb al-Jarmi admits that the clarity of Imam Ali’s (AS) argument during the Battle of the Camel left him no room for denial, compelling him to swear allegiance. This highlights the Shia concept of *Hujjah* (divine proof) as not merely rhetorical but an undeniable reality that forces recognition even from opponents, bridging theological authority with political legitimacy.
